# Verify a sampled tree manually via root-to-leaf distances for the first animal tree.
import zipfile, itertools, re
s=zipfile.ZipFile('inputs/scogs_animals.zip').read('1428854at2759.faa.mafft.clipkit.treefile').decode().strip()
print(s)
# For ((Ggal,Mmus):internal,Cele,Xlae) rooted trifurcation, pairwise distances are direct branch sums.
lengths=dict(re.findall(r'(Animals_[A-Za-z]+):([0-9.]+)', s))
lengths={k:float(v) for k,v in lengths.items()}
internal=float(re.search(r'\\):([0-9.]+),Animals_Xlae', s).group(1))
pairs=[]
for a,b in itertools.combinations(sorted(lengths),2):
    d=lengths[a]+lengths[b]
    if (a in {'Animals_Ggal','Animals_Mmus'}) "'^ (b in {'"'Animals_Ggal','Animals_Mmus'}):
        d += internal
    pairs.append(d)
print('manual_mean', sum(pairs)/len(pairs), 'pairs', pairs)
PY"
